markets: Global: Milan, Paris and Florence runways; premium and mid-market menswear
title: SS27 Men's Casualwear Styling
summary: Casual SS27 menswear: oversized tees and polos, shirts tied at the waist, "I ♥" graphics, shorts with sporty jackets and flip-flops with smart looks.

sections.heading: The evidence
sections.body: At Pitti Uomo, street style favoured oversized T-shirts, polos and colourful shirts tied around the waist<sup>[1]</sup>. In Paris, "I ♥" T-shirts were reinterpreted by 3.Paradis, Ami and Doublet; sporty jackets were layered over classic menswear; and lace-up ballet flats, boots and flip-flops were worn with both smart and athletic looks<sup>[2]</sup>. Dior styled a fluid check blazer with a loosely buttoned shirt, ripped jeans and a scarf-tie<sup>[2]</sup>.

sections.heading: Formulas
sections.body:
- **Oversized tee + tailored shorts + loafers.**
- **Polo + straight jeans + shirt tied at the waist.**
- **Graphic tee + check blazer + ripped jeans.**
- **Sporty jacket over shirt and tailored trousers.**
- **Camp shirt set + flip-flops or ballet flats.**

design_implications: - Design casual pieces in the season palette so they mix with tailoring.
commercial_implications: - Graphic tees and polos are reorder lines; keep them in core colours.

sources.title: Between heatwave and restraint: menswear trends from Paris
